commit_message:
[HIP] Keep allocation completion ordered with its signal stream (#25291)

Queue allocations run on the async memory stream and record their
signal-semaphore events there. The cleanup event that advances those
semaphores on the host, however, was always recorded on the dispatch
stream. Allocation completion was therefore observed independently of
the stream that performed it.

`iree_hal_hip_device_stream_add_cleanup` now records on the stream it is
given, and semaphore signalling passes the stream its events were
recorded on. Queue reads and submissions keep using the dispatch stream.

Assisted-by: Codex
